newsitem.title: USA: Pharmacyclics plans Phase II Lu-Tex trial.
newsitem.headline: Pharmacyclics plans Phase II Lu-Tex trial.

text.p: Pharmacyclics Inc said it plans to initiate Phase II testing in the second quarter of this year, based on the results of Phase I trials of its photosensitizer lutetium-texaphyrin (Lu-Tex).

Pharmacyclics said it completed Phase I clinical trials of its photosensitizer lutetium-texaphyrin (Lu-Tex) for advanced local or metastatic cancer and found that the product was well tolerated and the response rate promising.
Of the 35 patients enrolled in the dose escalation study, 15 had breast cancer, seven had melanoma, and 13 had other types of tumors.
